args.summary: Shipped checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to remediate the high error rate (18%) introduced by v2.3.1. Deployment required and received change-manager approval since v2.3.2 had not previously been healthy in production. Post-deploy verification: service healthy across all regions, error rate down to 0.2%.
args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to all production regions

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Deployment**: Shipped checkout-api hotfix **v2.3.2** to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Since v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production before, the deployment was routed through change-manager approval, which was granted, and the rollout completed successfully.
2. **Verification**: Post-deploy, checkout-api is healthy across all regions with the error rate reduced from 18% (v2.3.1) to 0.2%.
3. **Incident**: Opened a SEV3 incident (**INC-0001**, on-call paged) recording the hotfix deployment and the resulting recovery.
